deadline.value: Applications for Fall quarter are due December 15, 2026, including for fellowship and department support.
deadline.quote: with an application due date of December 15, 2026

gre_general.value: Do not send GRE General scores; they are not accepted.
gre_general.quote: please do not submit GRE General Exam scores as they will not be accepted with your other application materials

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is a required part of the application.
gre_subject.quote: Official GRE Mathematics Subject Exam scores. We only require the Subject exam scores

supervisor.value: Admission is by the faculty committee; students ask a faculty member to be their dissertation advisor after joining.
supervisor.quote: The student should ask a faculty member of the Mathematics Department to serve as his or her Dissertation Advisor.

funding.value: A PhD student making good progress can expect five years of support, but support is allocated competitively year to year.
funding.quote: Under normal circumstances, a Ph.D. student making good progress toward the degree can expect financial support for five years

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in mathematics or a closely related field is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree in mathematics or a closely related field.

notes: The admissions page still says 'next available admission quarter is Fall 2026' next to the December 15, 2026 date; it is read here as the Fall 2027 cycle.
